root_cause.text: In the NFC NCI subsystem, the `nci_transceive` function leaks memory because it assumes ownership of the input socket buffer (`skb`) but fails to call `kfree_skb` on early error return paths.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows `kfree_skb(skb)` added prior to returning `-EPROTO`, `-EINVAL`, and `-EBUSY` in `net/nfc/nci/core.c`, while the CVE description confirms the function takes ownership of the `skb` passed by the caller but previously returned without freeing it on these error paths.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leaks in nci_transceive by freeing the skb buffer on all identified error exit paths.
intent_record.what: Added kfree_skb(skb) calls to three error handling branches in nci_transceive and converted single-line if statements to multi-line blocks with braces.
intent_record.how: Ensures the socket buffer is properly deallocated when transmission fails due to missing connection info, inactive target, or busy flags, preventing memory leaks.
